content: Canonical tags: Shopify auto-generates canonicals (usually fine, but pagination/duplicate collection URLs need manual override via theme.liquid or app); Wix supports custom canonical URL per page in SEO panel; Webflow and Squarespace canonical control is limited/theme-dependent, often requires custom code embed. JSON-LD: Shopify modern themes (Dawn) ship Product/Organization/BreadcrumbList schema by default, extendable via apps (JSON-LD for SEO, Schema Plus) for custom types; Webflow has NO native schema support - must add JSON-LD manually via page settings custom code or Embed element; Wix auto-generates some basic schema per page type but it's incomplete and NOT user-editable/extensible - custom JSON-LD requires Wix Editor's custom code feature in <head>; Squarespace includes limited built-in schema, customizable by adding JSON-LD directly in code injection or blog post code blocks.
